title: Teray Saray Dard Wandawan Gi
body:
Teray saray dard wandawa’n gi Shabir main Zainab haan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Tu sajday ch sir nu katana aay main sir di rida lutwawa’n gi Shabir main Zainab haan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Teray Akbar Asghar toun veeran main inj da sadqa utara gi – Haye Aun o Mohammad waara gi
Putraan nu vi main na rowa gi na laashaan tay main aawa’n gi Shabir main Zainab haan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jeday maan tay karbal aana aay maa Umal Baneen da Jaya aay
Zainab ro vayn aay paya aay
Ghazi diyan bahwaa’n lathniya nay oday faraz main aap nibhawa’n gi Shabir main Zainab haan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ag khaimeya nu jado lagni aay beemar nu aap main chaawa’n gi Abid nu baahr leyawa’n gi
Meri nasal bhaway’n muk jani aay tera putar Sajjad bachawa’n gi Shabir main Zainab haan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Lenay Badr o Hunain day enj badlay wich kufay Ali di jaeya’n toun – Safraan diyan dard sataeya’n toun
Mee pathraan day loka’n wasanay nay main babay day badlay chukawa’n gi Shabir main Zainab haan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Akbar day qatil naal wi main karbal toun tursaa’n sham veeran – Na puch keewian karsa’n kalam veeran
Tu saang utay Quran parhee main khutbay aan sunawa’n gi Shabir main Zainab haan..
